description: This file defines the IDGeneratorDao class, which handles database operations related to generating and updating unique IDs for entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods to retrieve the current ID and update the next ID for a given entity class, utilizing Doctrine ORM.

classes.name: IDGeneratorDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for generating IDs, extending BaseDao and providing methods to get and update IDs related to specific entity classes.

methods.name: getCurrentID
methods.description: Retrieves the current last ID for a given entity class from the database, returning 0 if none exists.

methods.name: updateNextId
methods.description: Updates the last ID value for a given entity class to the specified next ID.

methods.name: getTableName
methods.description: Private helper method to retrieve the database table name associated with an entity class.
